 Follow Winning TAKE 5 lottery ticket sold at WNY convenience store
 Ian Caskie Sat, November 7, 2026 at 6:11 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. WGRZ A winning TAKE 5 ticket was sold at a Western New York bottle redemption and convenience store.
 The New York Lottery says that a winning ticket for the TAKE 5 midday drawing for November 6 was sold at Salamanca Redemption and Beverage, on Central Avenue in Salamanca.
 The ticket was the only winning ticket in New York, and is worth $19,853.
 RELATED: TAKE 5 top-prize ticket sold in Cattaraugus County 
 TAKE 5 drawings are held twice every day, at 2:30 p.m. and 10:30 p.m. The New York Lottery says winnings can be claimed up to a year after a ticket was drawn, the last day to claim this ticket will be October 2, 2027.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The TAKE 5 game numbers are drawn from a field of 1 through 39. If you or a loved one are struggling with gambling addiction and are looking for resources, visit NYProblemGamblingHelp.org . Those looking for help can also call the state's confidential toll-free HOPEline at 1-877-846-7369, or text HOPENY (467369).
